exams.name: NEET-UG 2026
exams.title: Official NEET (UG) 2026 Curriculum
exams.subtitle: National Medical Commission (NMC) & National Testing Agency (NTA) 50-Unit Medical Entrance Syllabus
exams.markingScheme: 720 Total Marks (Physics 180, Chemistry 180, Biology 360) • +4 for correct, -1 for incorrect

units.name: Physics and Measurement
units.topics: Units of measurements, System of Units, SI Units, fundamental and derived units, least count, significant figures, Errors in measurements, Dimensions of Physics quantities, dimensional analysis, and its applications.

units.name: Kinematics
units.topics: Frame of reference, motion in a straight line, Position-time graph, speed and velocity, Uniform and non-uniform motion, average and instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, velocity-time, position-time graph, Scalars and Vectors, Relative Velocity, Motion in a plane, Projectile Motion, Uniform Circular Motion.

units.name: Laws of Motion
units.topics: Force and inertia, Newton's laws of motion, Momentum, Impulse, Law of conservation of linear momentum, Equilibrium of concurrent forces, Static and Kinetic friction, rolling friction, Dynamics of uniform circular motion, centripetal force and applications.

units.name: Work, Energy, and Power
units.topics: Work done by constant force and variable force; kinetic and potential energies, work-energy theorem, power. Potential energy of spring, conservation of mechanical energy, conservative and non-conservative forces; motion in a vertical circle, Elastic and inelastic collisions in 1D and 2D.

units.name: Rotational Motion
units.topics: Centre of mass of two-particle system and rigid body; moment of force, torque, angular momentum, conservation of angular momentum; Moment of inertia, radius of gyration, parallel and perpendicular axes theorems, equations of rotational motion.

units.name: Gravitation
units.topics: Universal law of gravitation, Acceleration due to gravity (variation with altitude and depth), Kepler's laws, Gravitational potential energy, gravitational potential, Escape velocity, Motion of satellite, orbital velocity, time period and energy.

units.name: Properties of Solids and Liquids
units.topics: Elastic behaviour, Hooke's Law, Young's modulus, bulk modulus, shear modulus, Pressure in fluid, Pascal's law, Viscosity, Stokes' law, terminal velocity, Bernoulli's principle, Surface energy, surface tension, capillary rise, Heat, calorimetry, latent heat, Heat transfer.

units.name: Thermodynamics
units.topics: Thermal equilibrium, zeroth law of thermodynamics, concept of temperature, Heat, work, internal energy, First law of thermodynamics, isothermal and adiabatic processes, Second law of thermodynamics: reversible and irreversible processes.

units.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases
units.topics: Equation of state of perfect gas, work done on compressing gas, kinetic theory of gases: assumptions, concept of pressure, RMS speed of gas molecules, degrees of freedom, law of equipartition of energy, mean free path, Avogadro's number.

units.name: Oscillations and Waves
units.topics: Periodic motion, time period, frequency, Simple harmonic motion (SHM) and its equation, phase, oscillations of spring, energy in SHM, simple pendulum. Wave motion, longitudinal and transverse waves, speed of travelling wave, superposition of waves, standing waves, beats.

units.name: Electrostatics
units.topics: Electric charges, Coulomb's law, forces between multiple charges, superposition principle, continuous charge distribution. Electric field, electric dipole, torque in uniform field, Gauss's law and applications, Electric potential, capacitors in series and parallel, energy stored in capacitor.

units.name: Current Electricity
units.topics: Electric current, drift velocity, mobility, Ohm's law, electrical resistance, V-I characteristics, series and parallel combinations, temperature dependence, internal resistance, emf of cell, Kirchhoff's laws, Wheatstone bridge, Metre Bridge.

units.name: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
units.topics: Biot-Savart law, Ampere's law, solenoid. Force on moving charge in magnetic and electric fields, force on current conductor, torque on current loop: moving coil galvanometer. Bar magnet as equivalent solenoid, magnetic dipole moment, magnetic properties (dia, para, ferro).

units.name: Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents
units.topics: Faraday's law, induced emf and current, Lenz's law, eddy currents, self and mutual inductance. Alternating currents, peak and RMS value, reactance and impedance, LCR series circuit, resonance, power in AC circuits, AC generator and transformer.

units.name: Electromagnetic Waves
units.topics: Displacement current, electromagnetic waves and characteristics, transverse nature, electromagnetic spectrum (radio, micro, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays) and applications.

units.name: Optics
units.topics: Reflection of light, spherical mirrors, mirror formula, Refraction, thin lens formula, lens maker formula, total internal reflection, magnification, power of lens, refraction through prism, microscope and telescope. Wave optics: wavefront, Huygens principle, interference, Young's double slit experiment, diffraction, polarization.

units.name: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation
units.topics: Dual nature of radiation, Photoelectric effect, Hertz and Lenard's observations, Einstein's photoelectric equation, particle nature of light, Matter waves, de Broglie relation.

units.name: Atoms and Nuclei
units.topics: Alpha-particle scattering experiment, Rutherford's atom model, Bohr model, hydrogen spectrum. Composition and size of nucleus, atomic masses, mass-energy relation, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon, nuclear fission and fusion.

units.name: Electronic Devices
units.topics: Semiconductors, semiconductor diode, I-V characteristics in forward/reverse bias, diode as rectifier, I-V characteristics of LED, photodiode, solar cell, Zener diode as voltage regulator, Logic gates (OR, AND, NOT, NAND, NOR).

units.name: Experimental Skills
units.topics: Vernier calipers, Screw gauge, Simple pendulum, Metre scale principle of moments, Young's modulus, Surface tension, Co-efficient of viscosity, Speed of sound, Specific heat capacity, Resistivity of wire, Ohm's law, Galvanometer resistance, Focal length of mirrors/lenses, Prism angle of deviation, Refractive index of glass slab, p-n junction diode curves, Zener diode, Identification of components.

units.name: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry
units.topics: Matter and its nature, Dalton's atomic theory, Concept of atom, molecule, element, compound, Laws of chemical combination, Atomic and molecular masses, mole concept, empirical and molecular formulae, Chemical equations and stoichiometry.

units.name: Atomic Structure
units.topics: Nature of electromagnetic radiation, photoelectric effect, hydrogen spectrum, Bohr model, de Broglie relationship, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, quantum mechanics, quantum numbers, shapes of s, p, d orbitals, Aufbau principle, Pauli's exclusion principle, Hund's rule, electronic configuration.

units.name: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
units.topics: Ionic and covalent bonds, lattice enthalpy, electronegativity, Fajan's rule, dipole moment, VSEPR theory, Valence Bond theory, hybridization (s, p, d orbitals), Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT), hydrogen bonding.

units.name: Chemical Thermodynamics
units.topics: System and surroundings, state functions, First law of thermodynamics, heat, work, enthalpy, Hess's law, Enthalpies of bond dissociation, combustion, formation, phase transition. Second law of thermodynamics, entropy, Gibbs energy, spontaneity criteria.

units.name: Solutions
units.topics: Concentration terms (molality, molarity, mole fraction), Raoult's law, ideal and non-ideal solutions, Colligative properties: relative lowering of vapour pressure, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure, van't Hoff factor.

units.name: Equilibrium
units.topics: Dynamic equilibrium, physical equilibria, Law of chemical equilibrium, Kp and Kc, Le Chatelier's principle. Ionic equilibrium: acids and bases (Arrhenius, Bronsted-Lowry, Lewis), pH scale, common ion effect, hydrolysis of salts, solubility product, buffer solutions.

units.name: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry
units.topics: Oxidation number, balancing redox reactions, electrolytic and metallic conduction, Kohlrausch's law, Galvanic cells, standard electrode potential, Nernst equation, Gibbs energy of cell reaction, dry cells, fuel cells.

units.name: Chemical Kinetics
units.topics: Rate of reaction, factors affecting rate, order and molecularity, integrated rate equations (zero and first order), half-life, Arrhenius equation, activation energy, collision theory.

units.name: Classification of Elements & Periodicity
units.topics: Modern periodic law, periodic table trends in atomic/ionic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states, chemical reactivity.

units.name: p-Block Elements (Group 13 to 18)
units.topics: Electronic configuration and general trends in physical and chemical properties across periods and down groups, unique behaviour of first element in each group.

units.name: d- and f-Block Elements
units.topics: Transition elements: electronic configuration, oxidation states, atomic radii, catalytic properties, magnetic properties, alloy formation, K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4. Lanthanoids and Actinoids: configuration, oxidation states, lanthanoid contraction.

units.name: Coordination Compounds
units.topics: Werner's theory, ligands, coordination number, denticity, chelation, IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism, Valence Bond Theory, Crystal Field Theory, colour and magnetic properties.

units.name: Purification & Characterisation of Organic Compounds
units.topics: Crystallization, sublimation, distillation, chromatography. Qualitative analysis (detection of N, S, P, halogens). Quantitative estimation of C, H, N, halogens, S, P. Empirical and molecular formula calculations.

units.name: Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
units.topics: Tetravalency of carbon, hybridization, structural and stereoisomerism, IUPAC nomenclature, carbocations, carbanions, free radicals, electrophiles, nucleophiles, inductive effect, resonance, hyperconjugation.

units.name: Hydrocarbons
units.topics: Alkanes (conformations, halogenation), Alkenes (geometrical isomerism, electrophilic addition, Markownikoff's rule, ozonolysis), Alkynes (acidity, addition reactions), Aromatic hydrocarbons (benzene structure, electrophilic substitution, Friedel-Crafts reaction).

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Halogens
units.topics: Nature of C-X bond, mechanisms of substitution reactions (SN1, SN2), environmental effects of chloroform, iodoform, freons, DDT.

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen
units.topics: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers: preparation, dehydration, electrophilic substitution, Reimer-Tiemann. Aldehydes and Ketones: nucleophilic addition, Grignard, aldol condensation, Cannizzaro, haloform test. Carboxylic Acids: acidity.

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen
units.topics: Amines: classification, structure, basic character, diazotization. Diazonium Salts: synthetic importance in organic chemistry.

units.name: Biomolecules
units.topics: Carbohydrates (monosaccharides, disaccharides, polysaccharides), Proteins (amino acids, peptide bond, primary/secondary/tertiary structures, denaturation), Vitamins, Nucleic Acids (DNA & RNA structure and functions), Hormones.

units.name: Principles Related to Practical Chemistry
units.topics: Detection of functional groups (hydroxyl, carbonyl, carboxyl, amino), preparation of Mohr's salt, potash alum, acetanilide, iodoform. Titrimetric exercises (oxalic acid vs KMnO4, Mohr's salt vs KMnO4). Qualitative salt analysis of cations and anions.

units.name: Diversity in Living World
units.topics: What is living? Biodiversity; Need for classification; Three domains of life; Taxonomy & Systematics; Concept of species and taxonomical hierarchy; Binomial nomenclature; Five kingdom classification: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia; Salient features and classification of Plants and Animals.

units.name: Structural Organisation in Animals and Plants
units.topics: Morphology and modifications; Tissues; Anatomy and functions of different parts of flowering plants: Root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit and seed. Animal tissues; Morphology, anatomy and functions of digestive, circulatory, respiratory, nervous and reproductive systems of frog.

units.name: Cell Structure and Function
units.topics: Cell theory and cell as the basic unit of life; Structure of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cell; Plant cell and animal cell; Cell envelope, cell membrane, cell wall; Cell organelles; Biomolecules: structure and function of proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids; Enzymes; Cell division: Cell cycle, mitosis and meiosis.

units.name: Plant Physiology
units.topics: Photosynthesis as a means of Autotrophic nutrition; Site of photosynthesis, pigments involved, Photochemical and biosynthetic phases of photosynthesis; Cyclic and non-cyclic photophosphorylation; Chemiosmotic hypothesis; Photorespiration; C3 and C4 pathways; Cellular respiration: Glycolysis, fermentation, TCA cycle and electron transport system; Plant growth and development.

units.name: Human Physiology
units.topics: Breathing and Respiration in humans; Body fluids and circulation: Blood groups, coagulation, human circulatory system, ECG; Excretory products and their elimination; Locomotion and Movement: skeletal system, joints, muscle contraction; Neural control and coordination: CNS, PNS, nerve impulse; Chemical coordination and regulation: Endocrine glands and hormones.

units.name: Reproduction
units.topics: Sexual reproduction in flowering plants: Flower structure, development of male and female gametophytes, pollination, double fertilization, post-fertilization events, apomixis, polyembryony. Human Reproduction: Male and female reproductive systems, gametogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilization, pregnancy, embryonic development, parturition; Reproductive health.

units.name: Genetics and Evolution
units.topics: Heredity and variation: Mendelian inheritance, deviations from Mendelism (incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles), Chromosome theory of inheritance, Sex determination, Linkage and crossing over, Mendelian disorders in humans. Molecular basis of inheritance: DNA, RNA, replication, transcription, genetic code, translation, gene expression, Human Genome Project, DNA fingerprinting. Evolution: Origin of life, biological evolution, Darwin's contribution, modern synthetic theory, Hardy-Weinberg principle.

units.name: Biology and Human Welfare
units.topics: Health and Disease: Pathogens, parasites causing human diseases (malaria, filariasis, ascariasis, typhoid, pneumonia, common cold, amoebiasis, ringworm), Basic concepts of immunology, vaccines, Cancer, HIV and AIDS; Adolescence, drug and alcohol abuse. Microbes in human welfare: In household food processing, industrial production, sewage treatment, energy generation and as biocontrol agents and biofertilizers.

units.name: Biotechnology and Its Applications
units.topics: Principles and process of Biotechnology: Genetic engineering (Recombinant DNA technology). Application of Biotechnology in health and agriculture: Human insulin and vaccine production, gene therapy, Genetically modified organisms (Bt crops), Transgenic Animals, Biosafety issues, biopiracy and patents.

units.name: Ecology and Environment
units.topics: Organisms and environment: Population interactions (mutualism, competition, predation, parasitism), population attributes (growth, birth rate and death rate, age distribution). Ecosystem: Patterns, components, productivity and decomposition, energy flow, pyramids of number, biomass, energy. Biodiversity and its conservation: Concept, patterns, importance, loss of biodiversity, conservation strategies (hotspots, endangered organisms, extinction, Red Data Book, biosphere reserves, national parks and sanctuaries).

exams.name: JEE (Main) 2026
exams.title: Official JEE (Main) 2026 Syllabus
exams.subtitle: National Testing Agency (NTA) Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.) 54-Unit Engineering Entrance Curriculum
exams.markingScheme: 300 Total Marks (Mathematics 100, Physics 100, Chemistry 100) • +4 for correct, -1 for incorrect

units.name: Sets, Relations and Functions
units.topics: Sets and their representation; Union, intersection and complement of sets and their algebraic properties; Power set; Relations, type of relations, equivalence relations, functions; one-one, into and onto functions, the composition of functions.

units.name: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
units.topics: Complex numbers as ordered pairs of reals, Representation in the form a + ib and Argand diagram, algebra of complex numbers, modulus and argument. Quadratic equations in real and complex systems, relations between roots and coefficients, nature of roots, formation of quadratic equations.

units.name: Matrices and Determinants
units.topics: Matrices, algebra of matrices, type of matrices, determinants and matrices of order two and three, evaluation of determinants, area of triangles using determinants; Adjoint and inverse of square matrix; Test of consistency and solution of simultaneous linear equations in 2 or 3 variables.

units.name: Permutations and Combinations
units.topics: Fundamental principle of counting, permutations and combinations; Meaning of P(n, r) and C(n, r). Simple applications.

units.name: Binomial Theorem and Its Simple Applications
units.topics: Binomial theorem for a positive integral index, general term and middle term and simple applications.

units.name: Sequence and Series
units.topics: Arithmetic and Geometric progressions, insertion of arithmetic, geometric means between two given numbers, Relation between A.M and G.M.

units.name: Limit, Continuity and Differentiability
units.topics: Real-valued functions, algebra of functions; polynomial, rational, trigonometric, logarithmic and exponential functions; inverse functions. Graphs of simple functions. Limits, continuity and differentiability. Differentiation of sum, difference, product and quotient. Differentiation of composite and implicit functions; derivatives of order up to two. Applications of derivatives: Rate of change, monotonic functions, Maxima and minima.

units.name: Integral Calculus
units.topics: Integral as an anti-derivative, Fundamental integrals involving algebraic, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions. Integration by substitution, by parts and by partial fractions. Evaluation of standard integrals. Fundamental theorem of calculus, properties of definite integrals, determining areas bounded by simple curves.

units.name: Differential Equations
units.topics: Ordinary differential equations, order and degree, solution by method of separation of variables, solution of homogeneous and linear differential equations of type dy/dx + p(x)y = q(x).

units.name: Co-ordinate Geometry
units.topics: Cartesian system of coordinates in a plane, distance formula, section formula, locus, slope of a line, parallel/perpendicular lines. Straight line: various forms of equations, intersection, angle, concurrence, distance of a point from line, centroid, orthocentre, circumcentre. Circle and Conic sections: standard form of circle equation, radius and centre, diameter endpoints, points of intersection with lines, standard forms of parabola, ellipse and hyperbola.

units.name: Three Dimensional Geometry
units.topics: Coordinates of a point in space, distance between two points, section formula, direction ratios and direction cosines, angle between two intersecting lines. Equation of a line; Skew lines, shortest distance between them and its equation.

units.name: Vector Algebra
units.topics: Vectors and scalars, addition of vectors, components of a vector in 2D and 3D spaces, scalar and vector products (dot and cross products).

units.name: Statistics and Probability
units.topics: Measures of dispersion: calculation of mean, median, mode of grouped/ungrouped data, standard deviation, variance and mean deviation. Probability: probability of an event, addition and multiplication theorems, Bayes' theorem, probability distribution of a random variable.

units.name: Trigonometry
units.topics: Trigonometrical identities and trigonometrical functions, inverse trigonometrical functions and their properties.

units.name: Units and Measurements
units.topics: Units of measurements, System of units, SI Units, fundamental and derived units, least count, significant figures, Errors in measurements, Dimensions of Physics quantities, dimensional analysis and its applications.

units.name: Kinematics
units.topics: Frame of reference, motion in a straight line, speed and velocity, uniform and non-uniform motion, average speed and instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, graphs, relative velocity, Motion in a plane, projectile motion, uniform circular motion.

units.name: Laws of Motion
units.topics: Force and inertia, Newton's first, second and third laws of motion, momentum, impulse. Law of conservation of linear momentum, equilibrium of concurrent forces. Static and kinetic friction, laws of friction, rolling friction. Dynamics of uniform circular motion, centripetal force (level and banked road).

units.name: Work, Energy and Power
units.topics: Work done by constant force and variable force, kinetic and potential energies, work-energy theorem, power. Potential energy of spring, conservation of mechanical energy, conservative and non-conservative forces, motion in vertical circle, collisions in 1D and 2D.

units.name: Rotational Motion
units.topics: Centre of mass of two-particle system and rigid body. Moment of force, torque, angular momentum, conservation of angular momentum. Moment of inertia, radius of gyration, parallel and perpendicular axes theorems, equations of rotational motion.

units.name: Gravitation
units.topics: Universal law of gravitation. Acceleration due to gravity and variation with altitude/depth. Kepler's laws. Gravitational potential energy, gravitational potential. Escape velocity, satellite motion, orbital velocity, time period.

units.name: Properties of Solids and Liquids
units.topics: Elastic behaviour, stress-strain relationship, Hooke's Law, Young's, bulk and rigidity modulus. Pascal's law, viscosity, Stokes' law, terminal velocity, streamline/turbulent flow, Bernoulli's principle. Surface energy, surface tension, capillary rise. Heat, calorimetry, latent heat, heat transfer.

units.name: Thermodynamics
units.topics: Thermal equilibrium, zeroth law, heat, work, internal energy. First law of thermodynamics, isothermal and adiabatic processes. Second law: reversible and irreversible processes.

units.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases
units.topics: Equation of state, work done on compressing gas, kinetic theory assumptions, pressure concept, RMS speed, degrees of freedom, law of equipartition of energy, mean free path, Avogadro's number.

units.name: Oscillations and Waves
units.topics: Periodic motion, SHM and its equation, phase, spring oscillations, energy in SHM, simple pendulum. Wave motion, transverse and longitudinal waves, speed of wave, superposition principle, standing waves in strings/organ pipes, beats.

units.name: Electrostatics
units.topics: Coulomb's law, electric field, electric dipole and torque in uniform field, Gauss's law and applications (wire, plane sheet, spherical shell). Electric potential and potential energy, conductors/insulators, dielectrics, capacitors in series and parallel, energy in capacitor.

units.name: Current Electricity
units.topics: Drift velocity, mobility, Ohm's law, electrical resistance, resistivity, conductivity, temperature dependence, internal resistance, Kirchhoff's laws, Wheatstone bridge, Metre Bridge.

units.name: Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism
units.topics: Biot-Savart law, Ampere's law, solenoid. Force on moving charge and current conductor, torque on current loop, moving coil galvanometer. Bar magnet as equivalent solenoid, magnetic dipole moment, dia-, para-, and ferromagnetic materials.

units.name: Electromagnetic Induction & AC
units.topics: Faraday's law, Lenz's law, eddy currents, self and mutual inductance. Alternating currents, peak and RMS value, reactance, impedance, LCR series circuit, resonance, power in AC, AC generator, transformer.

units.name: Electromagnetic Waves
units.topics: Displacement current, characteristics of EM waves, transverse nature, EM spectrum (radio to gamma rays) and applications.

units.name: Optics
units.topics: Reflection, spherical mirrors, refraction, thin lens formula, lens maker formula, total internal reflection, magnification, power of lens, prism, microscope, telescope. Wave optics: wavefront, Huygens principle, interference, Young's double slit, diffraction, polarization, Brewster's law.

units.name: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation
units.topics: Photoelectric effect, Hertz and Lenard's observations, Einstein's photoelectric equation, matter waves, de Broglie relation.

units.name: Atoms and Nuclei
units.topics: Rutherford's model, Bohr model, hydrogen spectrum. Composition and size of nucleus, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon, nuclear fission and fusion.

units.name: Electronic Devices
units.topics: Semiconductors, p-n junction diode forward/reverse bias, diode as rectifier, LED, photodiode, solar cell, Zener diode as voltage regulator, Logic gates (OR, AND, NOT, NAND, NOR).

units.name: Experimental Skills
units.topics: Vernier calipers, screw gauge, simple pendulum, metre scale principle of moments, Young's modulus, surface tension, viscosity, resonance tube, specific heat, metre bridge resistivity, Ohm's law resistance, galvanometer figure of merit, focal lengths (mirrors/lenses), prism deviation, glass slab refractive index, p-n diode curves, Zener diode, component identification.

units.name: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry
units.topics: Matter, Dalton's atomic theory, atomic and molecular masses, mole concept, molar mass, empirical/molecular formula, stoichiometry.

units.name: Atomic Structure
units.topics: Photoelectric effect, Bohr model, de Broglie relation, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, quantum mechanical model, quantum numbers, orbital shapes, Aufbau/Pauli/Hund rules, electronic configurations.

units.name: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
units.topics: Ionic and covalent bonds, lattice enthalpy, Fajan's rule, dipole moment, VSEPR theory, Valence Bond Theory, hybridization, Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT), hydrogen bonding.

units.name: Chemical Thermodynamics
units.topics: First law of thermodynamics, heat, work, internal energy, enthalpy, Hess's law. Second law of thermodynamics, entropy, Gibbs free energy, spontaneity criteria, equilibrium constant relation.

units.name: Solutions
units.topics: Concentration terms, Raoult's law, ideal and non-ideal solutions, Colligative properties (vapour pressure lowering, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure), van't Hoff factor.

units.name: Equilibrium
units.topics: Chemical equilibrium, Kp and Kc, Le Chatelier's principle. Ionic equilibrium: ionization of acids/bases, pH, common ion effect, salt hydrolysis, solubility product, buffer solutions.

units.name: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry
units.topics: Oxidation numbers, redox balancing, electrolytic conductance, Kohlrausch's law, Galvanic cells, Nernst equation, Gibbs energy relation, batteries, fuel cells.

units.name: Chemical Kinetics
units.topics: Rate law, order and molecularity, zero and first-order integrated rate laws, half-life, Arrhenius equation, activation energy, collision theory.

units.name: Classification of Elements & Periodicity
units.topics: Modern periodic table trends in atomic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states, reactivity.

units.name: p-Block Elements (Group 13 to 18)
units.topics: Electronic configurations, periodic trends in physical/chemical properties, anomalous behaviour of first elements.

units.name: d- and f-Block Elements
units.topics: Transition elements characteristics, oxidation states, catalytic and magnetic properties, complex formation, K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4. Lanthanoids/Actinoids configurations and lanthanoid contraction.

units.name: Coordination Compounds
units.topics: Werner's theory, ligands, coordination number, IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism, Valence Bond and Crystal Field Theory, colour and magnetism.

units.name: Purification & Characterisation
units.topics: Crystallization, distillation, chromatography. Qualitative detection of N, S, halogens. Quantitative analysis of C, H, N, halogens, S, P. Formula calculations.

units.name: Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
units.topics: Carbon hybridization, structural/stereoisomerism, IUPAC nomenclature, carbocations, carbanions, free radicals, inductive/resonance/hyperconjugation effects.

units.name: Hydrocarbons
units.topics: Alkanes (conformations, halogenation), Alkenes (Markownikoff rule, ozonolysis), Alkynes (acidity, additions), Aromatic hydrocarbons (benzene, electrophilic substitution, Friedel-Crafts).

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Halogens
units.topics: Nature of C-X bond, SN1 and SN2 mechanisms, environmental effects of chloroform, iodoform, freons, DDT.

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen
units.topics: Alcohols, Phenols (Reimer-Tiemann), Ethers. Aldehydes & Ketones (nucleophilic addition, aldol condensation, Cannizzaro, haloform). Carboxylic acids.

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen
units.topics: Amines structure, classification, basicity. Diazonium salts preparation and synthetic applications.

units.name: Biomolecules
units.topics: Carbohydrates (monosaccharides, oligosaccharides), Proteins (amino acids, peptide bonds, denaturation), Nucleic acids (DNA/RNA), Vitamins, Hormones.

units.name: Principles of Practical Chemistry
units.topics: Functional group detection, preparation of inorganic/organic compounds (Mohr's salt, alum, iodoform), titrations with KMnO4, qualitative salt analysis.

exams.name: MHT-CET 2026
exams.title: Official MHT-CET 2026 Curriculum
exams.subtitle: State Common Entrance Test Cell Maharashtra Syllabus for Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy & Pharm.D
exams.markingScheme: Paper I: Mathematics (100 Marks) • Paper II: Physics & Chemistry (100 Marks) • Paper III: Biology (100 Marks) • 20% Std. XI + 80% Std. XII • No Negative Marking

units.name: Std. XI Prescribed Curriculum (20% Weightage - 10 Questions)
units.topics: Trigonometry II, Straight Line, Circle, Probability, Complex Numbers, Permutations and Combinations, Functions, Limits, Continuity, Conic Section.

units.name: Std. XII Complete Curriculum (80% Weightage - 40 Questions)
units.topics: Mathematical Logic, Matrices, Trigonometric Functions, Pair of Straight Lines, Vectors, Three Dimensional Geometry, Line and Plane, Linear Programming, Differentiation, Applications of Derivatives, Indefinite Integration, Definite Integration, Application of Definite Integration, Differential Equations, Probability Distributions, Binomial Distribution.

units.name: Std. XI Prescribed Curriculum (20% Weightage - 10 Questions)
units.topics: Vectors, Error Analysis, Motion in a plane, Laws of Motion, Gravitation, Thermal properties of matter, Sound, Optics, Electrostatics, Semiconductors.

units.name: Std. XII Complete Curriculum (80% Weightage - 40 Questions)
units.topics: Rotational Dynamics, Mechanical Properties of Fluids, Kinetic Theory of Gases and Radiation, Thermodynamics, Oscillations, Superposition of Waves, Wave Optics, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Fields due to Electric Current, Magnetic Materials, Electromagnetic Induction, AC Circuits, Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter, Structure of Atoms and Nuclei, Semiconductor Devices.

units.name: Std. XI Prescribed Curriculum (20% Weightage - 10 Questions)
units.topics: Some Basic concepts of chemistry, Structure of atom, Chemical Bonding, Redox reactions, Elements of group 1 and 2, States of Matter (Gaseous and Liquids), Adsorption and colloids (Surface Chemistry), Hydrocarbons, Basic principles of organic chemistry, Chemistry in everyday life.

units.name: Std. XII Complete Curriculum (80% Weightage - 40 Questions)
units.topics: Solid State, Solutions, Ionic Equilibria, Chemical Thermodynamics, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Elements of Groups 16, 17 and 18, Transition and Inner Transition Elements, Coordination Compounds, Halogen Derivatives, Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers, Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids, Amines, Biomolecules, Introduction to Polymer Chemistry, Green Chemistry and Nanochemistry.

units.name: Std. XI Prescribed Curriculum (20% Weightage - 20 Questions)
units.topics: Biomolecules, Respiration and Energy Transfer, Human Nutrition, Excretion and Osmoregulation.

units.name: Std. XII Complete Curriculum (80% Weightage - 80 Questions)
units.topics: Reproduction in Lower and Higher Plants, Reproduction in Lower and Higher Animals, Inheritance and Variation, Molecular Basis of Inheritance, Origin and Evolution of Life, Plant Water Relation, Plant Growth and Mineral Nutrition, Respiration and Circulation, Control and Coordination, Human Health and Diseases, Enhancement of Food Production, Biotechnology, Organisms and Populations, Ecosystems and Energy Flow, Biodiversity, Conservation and Environmental Issues.
